name: Lottery Winner Notification System
description: Sends congratulatory emails to customers who won tickets in FairTix's fair queue lottery system. Notifies winners with purchase details and a 24-hour deadline to complete checkout.
trigger: New winner entry added to lottery results spreadsheet
coreLogic: Monitors lottery results spreadsheet for new winners. Sends personalized congratulations email with event details, transparent pricing (emphasizing zero hidden fees), and checkout link. Updates spreadsheet with email delivery status and timestamp for tracking.
businessContext: FairTix operates an anti-bot ticketing platform with a 'fair queue' lottery system to combat scalpers. This workflow is the critical conversion bridge between lottery selection and actual ticket sales. The email template reveals their value proposition: transparent pricing with zero hidden fees, verified humans only, and time-limited purchase windows. The 24-hour deadline creates urgency while the transparent pricing messaging differentiates them from traditional ticketing platforms with hidden fees.
sideEffects: Spreadsheet status updated to '200' with delivery timestamp

impactProposal.reasoning: This is the only touchpoint that converts lottery winners into paying customers. Each missed notification is a guaranteed lost sale and opens the door for the next person in queue. The 24-hour deadline means timing is revenue-critical. Failure breaks the entire lottery-to-purchase conversion funnel.

businessBrief: The moment of truth notification that converts FairTix lottery winners into paying customers with a 24-hour conversion window.
timeSavingsEstimate: ~1 minute per winner notification — replaces manual email composition, winner lookup, and status tracking. At scale with hundreds of winners per event, saves significant manual effort. Confidence: benchmark-based.
revenueImpactEstimate: Direct revenue impact — each notification failure is a lost sale ranging from €20-200+ per ticket based on the template variables. High-value events could see thousands in lost revenue per failure. Confidence: data-driven.
failureImpact: Lottery winners never learn they won. They assume they lost and move on. Meanwhile, their reserved ticket expires after 24 hours and goes to the next person in queue. FairTix loses the sale and potentially damages their reputation when winners later discover they were selected but never notified. Support inquiries spike as confused winners contact customer service.
dataIn: Winner records from lottery results spreadsheet containing ID, Name, Email, EventName, TicketPrice
dataOut: Winner notification email sent to customer, spreadsheet updated with delivery status (200), timestamp, and message details

technicalEvidence.errorHandling: Has error workflow linked (oZy3vc0yli2xdR45) but Gmail node has no explicit retry configuration — defaults to retryOnFail: false. Single API failure means silent notification failure.
technicalEvidence.triggerInterval: Every minute polling of Google Sheets for new rows
keyFindings: Email template reveals anti-scalper business model with 'verified humans only'
Transparent pricing messaging (€0.00 hidden fees) differentiates from competitors
Workflow inactive despite being marked 'Published' — suggests testing/staging phase
Zero executions indicates this has never run in production
